topic: Discussion on OUI data tracking and usage
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main topics: 1) The status of predictive datasets for Joe&TheJuice (JCD). [p1] inquired about sending a follow-up email or retrieving data from i3 after the data was available. [me] confirmed that the data had been uploaded to S3 and that someone else would handle the formal communication.
2) A discussion arose regarding tracking changes in the OUI directory (specifically, differences in sensor counts). [p1] suggested logging the difference in vendor or sensor count over time for potential use during data anomalies. [me] advised against this, stating it might be overly complex and misleading due to variable data loading rates across different technologies (Wi-Fi, mobile, IoT).
Ultimately, no decision was made regarding tracking OUI changes.
